inventory_scope: Reviewed official sources concerning Liechtenstein residence and free movement, related procedure and remedies, and official operational guidance. EEA, Swiss, and third-country legal routes remain distinct.

entries.title: Personenfreizügigkeitsgesetz (PFZG), LR 152.21
entries.publisher: Liechtenstein Government Legal Services (Rechtsdienst der Regierung)
entries.version: Lilex current-text frame version 11; consolidation as of 1 January 2026; latest listed amendment LGBl 2025.397, effective 1 January 2026
entries.scope: Primary law governing entry, residence and family reunification for EEA/Swiss nationals and specified family/other-beneficiary categories, with a Liechtenstein-specific EEA solution and quota structure.
limitations: Lilex says consolidated laws are informational and have no legal effect; signed LGBl is authentic.
Source acceptance is separate from topic coverage and country review completion.
